question: What are the most affordable neighborhoods in Chesapeake, VA?
answer: Among the 26 Chesapeake neighborhoods with guides on this site (REIN MLS sales, November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026), Georgetown Colony had the lowest median sold price at $270,700, followed by Greenbrier ($275,000) and Riverwalk ($281,750). The Chesapeake city-wide median was $420,000.
answer_short: Georgetown Colony at $270,700, then Greenbrier and Riverwalk.
description: Chesapeake VA neighborhood ranking from REIN MLS closed sales: lowest median price, with sales counts and links to each guide.

This list covers the 26 Chesapeake neighborhoods that have guides on this site, based on closed sales in REIN MLS from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026. It is not every neighborhood, and neighborhoods follow MLS subdivision names. The ranking uses the median, so a few unusual sales do not decide it.

How to Use This List

A neighborhood's median describes the typical sale, not any one home. Compare the homes you are considering against recent sales on the same street, and check flood zone, association fees and noise zones for the specific address. Use the compare tool to put two neighborhoods side by side.
